evals.prompt: Do a deep research review on whether intermittent fasting improves insulin sensitivity in non-diabetic adults.
evals.expected_output: Frames an answerable question, searches primary scholarship, records methods and limitations, separates supporting and falsifying evidence, and writes a cited RESEARCH.md.
expectations: Defines search queries, inclusion/exclusion criteria, and target evidence types
Uses scripts/search_papers.py and fetches useful open full text when available
Records source metadata, methods, limitations, and read depth
Separates supporting from falsifying evidence
Synthesizes consensus, controversy, evidence quality, and residual risk without fabricated citations
Writes research/{slug}/RESEARCH.md and ends with DONE

evals.prompt: What does the scientific literature say about microplastics crossing the blood-brain barrier? Use standard mode.
evals.expected_output: Prioritizes biomedical primary sources, weights full text over abstracts, and calibrates conclusions to emerging evidence.
expectations: Prioritizes relevant trials, experiments, reviews, and official reports
Marks abstract-only evidence and weights it lower
Collects both supporting and falsifying evidence
Treats inconclusive evidence as a valid result
Clearly labels speculation and open questions

evals.expected_output: Answers directly without a literature-review workflow.
expectations: Does not build a corpus or spawn research roles
Answers Canberra directly

evals.expected_output: Summarizes the one supplied source directly.
expectations: Does not search for a literature corpus
Summarizes only the supplied text

evals.prompt: Do a quick literature check --quick on intermittent fasting and insulin sensitivity.
evals.expected_output: Honors quick mode with a focused 5-10 source scan, no subagents, honest limitations, and a concise cited report.
expectations: Honors quick mode
Uses 5-10 key scholarly sources
Does not spawn subagents
Includes evidence limitations and residual risk
Writes RESEARCH.md and ends with DONE
